summary: Smoke/regression test of the XField v3 'Pure Votes' code (pulled from GitHub) on the preview, with DEV_MODE off. Backend: 22 of 22 new pytest checks pass (tests/test_v3_smoke.py), and the repo's 16 unit tests (arena/writers/town) pass. Covered: /api/town (all keys, capacity 200, ?v= returns unchanged), /api/auth/me, the X OAuth 302 with PKCE S256 and the right redirect_uri, dev routes returning 404, residents paulg/levelsio/naval (200), unknown resident (404), card.jpg (a real JPEG), census list/latest/card, paper/latest, cron 401 (no or wrong bearer), 400 (bad body), accepted, and duplicate run_id. Arena: 401 signed out, 404 with a fake session whose house is dark, and the full vote flow after temporarily lighting 4 houses. The pair stays the same until you vote and never includes the voter; Elo +16/-16 between equals; left goes 3->2->0; a 4th vote returns 429. All of that data was restored. One real move-in (patio11) went queued->done(reserved) and added 9 houses plus a new district, Old Mill Road. The refresh cron re-read 8 houses and published Ledger No.1 with the AI writer, which works end to end. Frontend: the 3D city loads with 2 canvases (scene and minimap) and shows the XFIELD logo, '71/200 lots' and the docks/uptown chip, all 8 district labels with face stacks, and the place buttons (City Hall, Post Office, Arrivals, The Docks, Timeline, Ledger). Each place opens its panel. The Ledger pops up automatically for a new issue and closes with x or Esc (xf_paper is stored). Clicking a ticker item flies to the house and opens its HouseCard. 'Sign in with X' goes to x.com/i/oauth2/authorize. There were no page errors. Mobile 390x800 renders with no horizontal overflow. The old 2D routes /h/paulg, /census, /census/1 and an unknown /h/ handle all render without crashing.

minor.issue: migrate_to_night -> refresh_neighbourhoods logged 6 fresh 'new_nb' events at migration time (19:00:39) for districts that already existed, plus 1 more at 19:02. So the first paper headline reads 'Eight New Districts Open Across XField Today!' and the ticker/Timeline list them all as new. This is a migration side effect, not real city news, which goes against the README's 'Nothing fake' rule.
new_nb event 'h' doesn't always match the current district host. Ivy Gardens event says 'home of @elonmusk' but neighbourhoods[].host = sama; Station Row event says @bascodes but host = levelsio.
1 migrated resident has name stored as '@handle' (levelsio: n='@levelsio'), so the UI may show '@@levelsio' in places that prefix with '@'.

Historical census issue 1 still says capacity 100 (53/100) and is titled 'LEDGER No. 1 / XFIELD CITY LEDGER' in the old 2D sheet. This clashes with the new 'The XField Ledger' newspaper name and the 200 capacity.

All 71 residents are reserved (0 finished). Nobody can vote until real users sign in: arena pool is empty and require_citizen returns 404 'Light your house first.' This is expected with DEV_MODE off, but the vote card and ladder can't be seen on the preview.

ui_bugs.issue: The v3 UI has zero data-testid attributes (the old 2D TownPage still has them). This blocks robust automation; tests had to use role/text selectors.

A normal Playwright click on the floating place labels times out after waiting for stability (labels are re-transformed every frame), so dispatch_event was needed. Real mouse users are unaffected, but automation is.

issues: The 'Your house is already here / Sign in with X' card (bottom-left, ~330px wide) covers most of the minimap (bottom-right, 200x170 at x167-367, y575-745).

A flat light-blue rectangle renders inside the WebGL canvas at the top centre (about x 390-1645, y 0-35) in every frame, regardless of camera position. It may be a headless SwiftShader artifact; check on a real GPU.
The '📰 The Timeline' label sits partly off-screen at top (y=-12) on initial load.
The Arrivals panel is completely empty (town.newest=[] because nobody is lit) with no empty-state text.
Buildings stream in over ~5-8s (an early screenshot showed only City Hall, cars and trees). No loading indicator after the logo splash.

Repeated 'THREE.GLTFLoader: Couldn't load texture Textures/colormap.png' errors. The files exist (public/models/*/Textures/colormap.png); the requests show net::ERR_ABORTED, probably aborted or duplicated texture loads. Rendering is not broken.

action_items: Add data-testid to the v3 UI: header lots chip, place buttons, PlaceCard, HouseCard, VoteCard (pick/next), sign-in button, Newspaper modal and close, ticker items, minimap.

Stop migrations/refresh_neighbourhoods from emitting 'new_nb' events for districts that already existed, or remove the 6 migration-time new_nb events (at 2026-10-24T19:00:39) so the paper doesn't call them new. Consider re-issuing Ledger No.1.
On mobile, stack or hide the minimap when the sign-in card is shown (they overlap).
Add an Arrivals empty state ('Nobody has moved in yet').
Fix the stray '@' in levelsio's stored name.
Optionally check the top-centre light-blue band in the 3D scene on a real GPU.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1921 lines and should be split (auth, arena, paper/census, districts, crons, migrations).
/api/cron/refresh runs publish_paper right after the refresh, so any accepted refresh call can publish a paper (at most once per 20h). Calling it in preview published Ledger No.1.
Old district/board/election endpoints (/districts/*) and the 2D TownPage are still live, as the README notes. The 2D census sheet still uses 'Ledger' wording, which clashes with the new paper.
/api/arena with a signed-in but unlit user returns 404 'Light your house first.' A 403/409 would describe this state more accurately than 404.
seed_data_creation: Real move-in of @patio11 (kept: patio11 + 8 reserved neighbours + district 'Old Mill Road'; taken 62->71). Refresh cron published paper No.1 (kept, real cron behaviour). Arena test data (4 houses temporarily lit, fake session, votes, matchups) fully restored; TEST_ cron_runs removed. Full mongodump taken before testing at /tmp/xf_backup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v3 3D UI has no data-testids. Use role/text selectors, e.g. get_by_role('button', name='🏛 City Hall'), and dispatch_event('click') for the floating labels. Set localStorage xf_paper=<latest issue> to suppress the Ledger popup. The fake-session recipe works: insert into sessions {token_hash: sha256(T), k, h, expires_at} and send cookie xf_session=T. Voting needs the voter plus at least 2 others with status 'finished' and seen_at within 7 days. tests/test_v3_smoke.py lights levelsio/naval/paulg/sama temporarily and restores them. pytest.ini forces -n 2; use -o addopts='' for serial runs.
